content.name: Chloe Papadopoulos
content.title: Front-End Developer (Vue / Nuxt)
content.summary: Front-end developer with nearly ten years in Melbourne, moving from agency builds to product work in energy retail and travel. Currently own the booking front end for a tour operator taking $38 million a year online. Known for turning slow, fragile checkouts into fast, well-tested ones.

experience.title: Junior Web Developer
bullets: Developed marketing sites in Vue and Craft CMS for arts festivals, wineries and two local councils.
Set up automated visual regression checks with BackstopJS, catching layout breaks before clients saw them.
Answered client support tickets directly, which taught me to explain technical trade-offs without jargon.

experience.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Rebuilt the plan-comparison and sign-up journey in Nuxt, lifting online sign-ups by 23% over the following two quarters.
Implemented address autocomplete and concession-card validation that dropped incomplete applications by about 30%.
Worked with the compliance team so pricing displays met Victorian Default Offer comparison rules on every plan card.
Added unit and component tests that brought front-end coverage from near zero to 65%.

experience.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Own the tour-booking front end that processes about $38 million in online sales a year across web and in-app webviews.
Cut mobile checkout time from 4 minutes 10 seconds to 2 minutes 30 by redesigning traveller details with the UX team.
Moved image delivery to responsive formats and a CDN, improving mobile Largest Contentful Paint from 3.6 s to 1.9 s.
Mentor a graduate developer and lead fortnightly front-end chapter sessions for nine developers.

achievements.title: Organiser, Melbourne Vue meetup
achievements.detail: Co-run a bi-monthly meetup of about 80 developers since 2021.

achievements.title: Customer impact award, Bayside Energy Retail
achievements.detail: Recognised for the redesigned sign-up journey and its effect on complaints.
